content:
Wow it’s interesting how any posts about cryptocurrency instantly get downvoted. Crypto is our ONLY alternative to CBDCs, and yet people in here are so hostile towards them.
Blockchain technology is neutral, it can be used for good or bad. If we don’t actively support its use for financial freedom by talking about the pros and cons of various crypto projects, then by default it will go the way that the bad actors intent it to go, which is complete financial slavery and tyranny. I posted about BCH, this seems to me the most likely project to succeed and provide financial freedom. Monero is another amazing project but I think it is too private and therefore won’t stand a chance against government crackdown. Let’s open a discussion, does anyone see any other escape routes from CBDCs?
